content: Clinical trials, such as the FOURIER study, have demonstrated that the use of PCSK9 inhibitors, including evolocumab, leads to a substantial reduction in low-density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol levels. These trials have also shown a significant decrease in atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) events, particularly in populations at high risk. The efficacy of this therapeutic approach has been especially pronounced in individuals with diabetes.
